color.note: Every value is red-shifted; no pure black, no pure white. Accent is used on interactive/active surfaces only, never on body text.

icons.system: Phosphor (icon font, regular weight, single stroke)
icons.brandmark: MK monogram in a filled bordeaux disc (mk-icoon-bordeaux.svg)

designMap.shadows: none meaningful; depth via color-band changes and frosted glass (rgba(23,10,12,0.42) + blur)

tasteDNA.trigger: Needs a premium ground that flatters dark food photography
tasteDNA.reason: Pure black reads cold and flattens warm food; a red-shifted near-black keeps a wine-cellar warmth and lets the plated food be the brightest thing on screen
tasteDNA.evidence: pageBackground rgb(23,10,12); surfaces rgb(31,14,17)/rgb(42,19,23) all red-shifted

tasteDNA.decision: One heavy display face (Lilita One, single weight, uppercase) carries ALL hierarchy; Montserrat only for body/labels
tasteDNA.reason: Hierarchy comes from size not weight, so headings stay characterful and body stays legible; two families instead of five keeps the voice consistent
tasteDNA.evidence: h1 136px Lilita One uppercase vs body 11.5px Montserrat 500; only 3 families loaded

tasteDNA.decision: Accent bordeaux #7B0D1E marks status and one emphasis per view, never body text, never a large block beside food
tasteDNA.reason: Restraint reads as expensive and the food supplies the real color; spending red everywhere would compete with the plate
tasteDNA.evidence: accentCandidates are cream/tan on text; #7B0D1E only on buttons/active surfaces

tasteDNA.trigger: Many small UI marks are needed across the site
tasteDNA.decision: All icons come from one line system (Phosphor, single weight); the brandmark is MK in a filled bordeaux disc; emoji are banned
tasteDNA.reason: A single icon grammar keeps dozens of small marks reading as one family and matches the confident weight of Lilita One; mixed illustration styles or emoji would fracture the tone
tasteDNA.evidence: Phosphor font loaded on page; mk-icoon-bordeaux.svg is a filled disc; design.md states 'Iconen: Phosphor regular. Nooit emoji.'
